_note: Shot types and scenes for the dashboard. Text for packshot-front and on-model-front is copied verbatim from the approved test specs. On-model recipes take background and lighting from the chosen scene; packshots ignore the scene.

packshot-front.label: Packshot, front
packshot-front.purpose: Front-view anchor packshot of a single hoodie for the product page, shown as a ghost-mannequin catalogue shot with the body shape filled out and no visible mannequin

camera.framing: whole garment centred with even margins on all sides

packshot-front.lighting: soft, even studio light from a large overhead softbox with gentle front fill, showing the fleece texture
packshot-front.background: seamless light grey studio background with a soft natural shadow below the hem

packshot-back.label: Packshot, back
packshot-back.purpose: Back-view packshot of a single hoodie for the product page, shown as a ghost-mannequin catalogue shot with the body shape filled out and no visible mannequin

camera.angle: straight on at chest height from behind
camera.framing: whole garment centred with even margins on all sides

packshot-back.lighting: soft, even studio light from a large overhead softbox with gentle front fill, showing the fleece texture
packshot-back.background: seamless light grey studio background with a soft natural shadow below the hem
must_show: the hood lying flat with its centre seam

on-model-front.label: On model, front
on-model-front.purpose: Three-quarter-length on-model shot for the product page, showing the oversized fit and heavyweight drape

camera.angle: at chest height, slightly to the model's right
camera.framing: head to mid-thigh with the model centred

on-model-front.lighting: soft window-style key light from camera left with gentle fill
on-model-front.pose: standing relaxed with weight on one leg, one hand in the kangaroo pocket, looking just off camera

on-model-back.label: On model, back
on-model-back.purpose: Three-quarter-length on-model shot from behind for the product page, showing the back panel, hood and heavyweight drape

camera.angle: at chest height, directly behind the model
camera.framing: head to mid-thigh with the model centred

on-model-back.lighting: soft window-style key light from camera left with gentle fill
on-model-back.pose: standing relaxed with weight on one leg, back to camera, head turned slightly to one side, arms loose at the sides
must_show: the hood resting on the shoulders with its centre seam

decoration-closeup.label: Decoration close-up
decoration-closeup.purpose: Close-up detail shot of the decoration on the hoodie for the product page, showing the stitching or print texture and the surrounding fleece

camera.angle: straight on, slightly above the decoration
camera.framing: the decoration filling most of the frame with a little fabric around it

decoration-closeup.lighting: soft raking side light that shows the texture of the decoration and the fleece
decoration-closeup.background: the garment fabric fills the frame
must_show: the decoration crisp and fully in frame

flat-lay.label: Flat lay
flat-lay.purpose: Flat-lay shot of a single hoodie laid on a surface for the product page, with sleeves relaxed at the sides and the body shape clearly visible

camera.framing: whole garment centred with even margins on all sides

flat-lay.lighting: soft, even overhead daylight with a gentle natural shadow around the edges, showing the fleece texture

studio-grey.label: Studio grey
studio-grey.background: seamless light grey studio background with a soft natural shadow below the hem
studio-grey.lighting: soft, even studio light from a large overhead softbox with gentle front fill, showing the fleece texture

warm-studio.label: Warm studio
warm-studio.lighting: soft window-style key light from camera left with gentle fill

concrete-daylight.label: Concrete and daylight
concrete-daylight.background: unpainted concrete wall in an urban courtyard
concrete-daylight.lighting: soft overcast daylight from above and in front with gentle natural fill

warm-cafe.label: Warm cafe
warm-cafe.background: softly blurred warm cafe interior with wooden tables and amber lights
warm-cafe.lighting: warm window light from camera right mixed with soft ambient interior glow
